annotator.notes: The tutor strictly follows the method_only policy, refusing to confirm the final numeric value even when the student proposes it, instead redirecting to the process.

task_context.problem_statement:
Zachary did 51 push-ups in gym class today. David did 22 more push-ups than Zachary. John did 4 push-ups less than David.
How many push-ups did John do?
( ( 51.0 + 22.0 ) - 4.0 )
